6:34 PM
Here's how it'll go, there's 4 different events (which I will post shortly) and I will need you to then coordinate with your tribe on which event to take part in (some will require multiple players). (edited)
6:34 PM

Event 1 - Season One Trivia

-# Please assign one player for this event If you view the Truce Information Category, which is the category that contains https://discord.com/channels/1367508442524287077/1445256015250587669 You can see the different channels pertaining to season one, get a bit familiar with these channels as your goal is to answer a quiz about the different information regarding players, edgic and even the patrons themselves. The winner of this challenge will be awarded to the players who gets the most correct answer, the tiebreaker will be time. In your submission do: !olympics-seasonone

--------------------------------------------------

Event 2 - Typing Test

-# Please assign one player for this event Do you got fast fingers? Well, our next challenge is type racer! This will be straight forward as you're just required to complete a typing test. The winner will be awarded to the one who typed out the most amount of words while the tie breaker will be given to the player who completes the test in the quickest time. In your submission do: !olympics-race ### --------------------------------------------------
6:35 PM

Event 3 - Wavelength ( 2 Players )

-# Please assign two players for this event The classic game of wavelength! If you are not familiar with the rules, here it is: https://www.wikihow.com/Play-Wavelength and the clue giving rules: https://www.ultraboardgames.com/wavelength/clue-giving.php tldr; I will provide each player a prompt and a number (don't share this info with your partner), you will be giving them a clue to help them guess the target number. for example: Weak 0 <--> 100 strong, (Target Number: 50) 0 represents something very weak so Remi! 100 would represent something very strong like Gorilla! since the number target provided is 50, we will provide the clue SJ! From there, I will provide the Scale (Weak 0 <-> 100 Strong) and the clue provided (SJ) to your partner, where their goal is to guess the target number that they best believe SJ falls under. From there points will be assigned based on how close of a guess it was compared to the target number. Scoring System:
  • Within 5: 4 Points
  • Within 15: 3 Points
  • Within 25: 2 Points

    --------------------------------------------------

    ## Event 4 - Team Jigsaw ( 3 Players )
-# Please assign three players for this event This challenge can be done whenever, just need 3 players on your tribe to coordinate a time together and from there complete a jigsaw puzzle which will be done in your realm's submission channel. I will provide a link for this, and there's no time limit on how long you want to do this, please ensure you are doing the 105 pieces puzzle otherwise the submission will be invalid. Your objective is to complete this jigsaw in the shortest amount of time possible!

9:32 PM

7
9:37 PM
You'll have to assign one member of the group to each of these roles: The Mouth
This member will receive the finished painting, which is a Google Spreadsheet. They'll hop into a VC with one other member of their group. They will have to relay the painting to this teammate but...
The Ears
They're mute! The Ears will be the second person within the VC. Unfortunately, they've lost their ability to speak and are server muted! They will only be able to listen to The Mouth and will have to relay the information they're given in TEXT to...
The Eyes
The final member of the team. The Eyes will be in charge of painting the actual picture. They'll be given a blank spreadsheet with the empty canvas and the color palette.
 (edited)
9:41 PM
Here are the basic rules:
  • The Mouth may only speak to The Ears.
  • The Ears may only text to The Eyes.
  • The Eyes may speak to NO ONE.
  • Only The Mouth will receive the finished spreadsheet.
  • Only The Eyes will receive the blank canvas spreadsheet.
  • A member of Production MUST be in the VC with The Mouth and The Ears during their run. How the game works:
  • The Eyes will merely be coloring in a 26x26 grid with the colors relayed to them by The Ears.
  • You will be GRADED on accuracy first, then time taken.
  • The two groups made will receive different paintings. THE MOUTH AND THE EYES WILL NEED A COMPUTER.

# TROJAN WAR
9:12 PM
Each realm will begin the war commanding a force of 15 soldiers (which will represent the amount of health points for your tribe). Each round, your realm will decide on three actions to either Attack, Defend, or Train. Actions Attack - You will roll a 2-5 die, where the number rolled will represent the damage you will do to the tribe (you still do 2-5 damage even if you have less than the amount of troops of the dice roll). Defend - Lets you block any attack successfully and captures an enemy troop. You may not select this action 2 turns in a row. Train - Gain +1 soldier (up to 20). If you get attacked, this action gets voided. Targeting Rules
  • You can only target one team per Attack.
  • If your chosen target is already eliminated, your attack fails that round.
  • When a realm’s soldiers are reduced to 0, they are eliminated from the war. At the end of every round, your realm will receive an update on your current troop.
I will also open up 1on1 tribal chat with the other tribes where you can talk to them about strategy. So, @Heralds please designate a War Commander who will basically be the one responsible for pinging me with your decision, they will have the final say with all your moves.

The backstory of this particular Patron, while an interesting concept, didn't make sense in totality. It was missing these key points, in my opinion:
  • a reason for godhood (loss of a spouse and devotion/love is not a unique experience)
  • a personal achievement, rather than one founded upon another person (specifically a man in a woman's story)

Once you have completed the challenge, be sure to send a screenshot and ping production. The winner of the challenge will be given to the player who complete the challenge with the tiebreaker being time like always! The command to start this is !codebreaker Please ping SJ if you have any questions!
